# arcane_api_resources (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cluster scoped api resource
data "arcane_api_resources" "ns" {
  api_version = "v1"
  kind        = "Namespace"
}

# Namespaced api resource
data "arcane_api_resources" "pod" {
  api_version = "v1"
  kind        = "Pod"
  namespace   = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_version` (String) API version of the resource (e.g., 'v1' or 'apps/v1')
- `kind` (String) Kind of the resource (e.g., 'ConfigMap', 'Deployment')

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the resource (optional, if provided lists namespaced resources, otherwise lists cluster resources)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `objects` (List of String) List of resource objects as YAML strings
